new_meta.title: Politique de confidentialité | Thuê xe máy Nguyễn Hà (unchanged)
new_meta.description: Ce que fr.rentbikehanoi.com traite vraiment : ni formulaire ni outil d’analyse, assistant local, choix du thème, hébergeur GitHub Pages, liens Zalo et WhatsApp.

evidence.FACTS: Every statement maps to code_audit: no account/form/newsletter; no analytics/ad/tracking tag and no cookie written by site code; all assets same-origin; only localStorage key « theme » (light/dark) on toggle use; open/closed computed locally; assistant downloads constant-URL same-origin index on open and processes text locally, nothing sent/stored; tel/Zalo/WhatsApp/Google Maps are plain links (no embed), browser may send origin as referrer (no referrer-policy set); GitHub Pages IP logging quoted from GitHub docs; GSC verification meta described as static text. Unknown practices (retention, access, response delay) explicitly stated as not yet published → ask the shop. No legal regime, DPO, retention period or rights catalogue invented.
evidence.INTENT: Navigational/trust « politique de confidentialité »; owner URL /confidentialite/; distinct from /conditions/ (scope of information) — this page covers data flows only.
evidence.CONTENT: All template sections + filler replaced (old copy wrongly said the site offers an email address). H2s: En bref (7-point summary); Qui est responsable du site; Ce que le site enregistre dans votre navigateur; Hébergement du site par GitHub Pages; L’assistant : ce que deviennent vos questions; Quand vous contactez Thuê xe máy Nguyễn Hà (tel, Zalo, WhatsApp, Google Maps + advice not to send ID copies unless required); Vos demandes sur vos informations; Mises à jour de cette politique (« Dernière mise à jour : 29 octobre 2026 », also in lead); FAQ ×4 (cookies, Analytics/pixel, assistant storage, deleting messages); Pour aller plus loin.
evidence.META: Title unchanged (52 chars); meta 160 chars, og:description identical. Matrix sync required for meta_description only (FND-006 in data/seo-cluster-matrix.json and data/seo-foundation-matrix.json).
evidence.LINKS: Required /contact/, /conditions/, /a-propos/ present. External citations (rel noopener) to the 5 retrieved policy URLs below.
evidence.AEO_GEO: « En bref » bullet summary answers the main privacy questions immediately; 4 FAQ with yes/no answers grounded in code; GitHub statement attributed and dated.

checks: seo_page_check: only meta sync error; review hits = passport/legal advice sentence (advice only). Invariants byte-identical to HEAD; tag balance OK; in-memory render OK.

O06: channel, language and response time for access/correction/deletion requests; whether a named privacy contact should be published
O06/O08: any plan to add analytics (GA4), forms, embedded maps or chat services — the policy must be updated before activation
O07: who controls the GitHub account/Pages site and Search Console property (token present on homepage); GitHub Pages IP logs are GitHub's processing
